title: A run that reuses an already booted simulator takes no lease.
ruling: Rewritten 2026-11-18 20:56 CST by triage to match main, on the consultant's ruling of 20:52 CST Nov 18 on page item 737 (option a, main's rules win; the consultant speaks for the owner under own-consultant-speaks-for-owner); wording from PR 3704's body (open draft, read by REST 20:56 CST). The earlier text (every session leases the shared phone before it drives it) is replaced.
